articles.title: Lockheed Martin eyes first C-130J assembly line outside US, in India
articles.summary: Lockheed Martin is exploring setting up a C-130J Super Hercules military transport aircraft final assembly line in India. This landmark move would be the first outside the US, significantly bolstering India's defence manufacturing capabilities and strategic partnership. It highlights efforts towards indigenous production of critical military assets, aligning with 'Make in India' defence initiatives.

articles.title: India, France near mega rafale deal amid IAF gaps
articles.summary: India and France are nearing a significant deal for additional Rafale fighter jets to address the Indian Air Force's inventory shortfall. This strategic acquisition underscores India's commitment to modernizing its defence capabilities and enhancing air power readiness. For SSB aspirants, this signals the growing importance of international defence collaborations and robust military infrastructure in national security.

articles.title: As the Arctic warms up, the race to control the region is growing ever hotter
articles.summary: Former US President Donald Trump and his officials advocated for the US acquisition of Greenland from Denmark, citing critical national security interests. This proposal, though rejected by Denmark, underscored Greenland's significant strategic importance in the Arctic region. For SSB aspirants, this highlights the growing geopolitical competition and the strategic value of geographical assets in global defense considerations.

articles.title: ‘Unhappy’ Putin sends message to West with Ukraine strike on EU border
articles.summary: Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko announced the deployment of Russia's nuclear-capable 'Oreshnik' missile system in Belarus. This strategic move, confirmed by Lukashenko, signifies a significant military development and further integration of Russian advanced weaponry within its ally's territory, potentially impacting regional security dynamics and showcasing Russia's extended defense posture. Aspirants should note implications for European security.

articles.title: Netflix’s Indian Top Gun is Coming: Everything We Know About ‘Operation Safed Saagar’
articles.summary: Inspired by hits like 'Top Gun: Maverick', Indian cinema is experiencing a resurgence of interest in air warfare films. Recent and upcoming productions such as 2024’s 'Fighter' and 2025’s 'Sky Force' exemplify this trend. This renewed focus on military aviation narratives reflects a growing cinematic exploration of airborne defence, potentially boosting public engagement with the armed forces.

articles.title: ‘We don’t know what’s coming’: Unease in Greenland as Donald Trump revives Arctic ambition
articles.summary: The article describes Nuuk, Greenland's capital, as a distinctive settlement of multicoloured wooden homes amidst snowy hills. It creatively compares Nuuk's unique landscape to a setting Astrid Lindgren, Pippi Longstocking's creator, might envision for a 'Nordic western,' highlighting its picturesque and rugged international appeal.
